query:
SELECT cs.id as slot_id, cs.sold, cs.sale_id, cs.consultation_date, cs.consultation_time,
       s.id as sale_id_in_sales, s.client_name, s.client_phone, s.seller_id,
       u.display_name as seller_name, u.username
FROM consultation_slots cs
LEFT JOIN sales s ON cs.sale_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN users u ON s.seller_id = u.id
WHERE cs.sold = true
LIMIT 10;
